explanations.message: Training age intermediate (18 months of consistent training).
Tier 1 (full VOL-04 band): chest, side_delts, lats, upper_back, quads, hamstrings, glutes; tier 2 (0.6 × band): rear_delts, biceps, triceps, abs, calves; tier 3 has no target.

Sets are fitted into 60-minute sessions (≈ 1.75–4 min per set incl. rest), ≤ 25 sets per session, ≤ 12 sets per muscle per session and ≥ 2 sets per exercise; a prime mover earns 1 set, a synergist 0.5.
Each week covers knee-dominant, hinge, horizontal and vertical/incline push and pull patterns; 71 % of the sets are compounds (target 60–75 %).
